summary: Keep the fleet shard transition test valid when the compatibility baseline already holds the shard

replay.detail: Only compatibility test expectations change; production claim replay is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The fleet test conditions shard-transition expectations on whether the baseline already opens the shard, while retaining graph sync, history and stream receipt checks. Production contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Test-only expectation changes require no service restart or migration.

manual.detail: No manual upgrade steps are required.

recovery.detail: No production state or recovery path changes.
